entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Performance and interactivity issues when using the 10.0.x packages for Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebView.Wpf #67404

Closed

  • BlazorWebView: model blazor.modules.json as a Framework asset (fixes publish-time Sequence contains more than one element in MAUI Blazor Hybrid + RCL) #67374
  • Support internal request DTOs in built-in Minimal API validation #65632
  • [Blazor] Analyzer to warn about caching User instances without subscribing to changes #65337
    Backlog
  • Revise obsolete APIs intended to be removed, and consider removing in .NET 11 #66551
  • File result types don't evaluate If-Unmodified-Since unless enableRangeProcessing is set #67216
  • API proposal for `AnchorMode` #66799
    11.0-preview6
  • Suggestion: Expose a parameter of `ShouldMatch` for `<NavLink />` #18163
    Backlog
  • [Blazor] StateHasChanged analyzer to flag unnecessary calls. #65196
    .NET 11 Planning
  • API Proposal: Add InitialIndex parameter and ScrollToIndexAsync method to Virtualize<TItem> #67065
    11.0-preview6
  • URL Rewrite middleware does not detect scheme-relative URLs (//host) in redirect targets #66486
  • WASM EnvironmentBoundary not always renders correct #67067
    11.0-preview7
  • Perf regression: kestrel-header-symbols, tls-renegotiation-kestrel #67392
